views.name: docket_bill_drift_delta
views.definition:
WITH version_traits AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT bv.genome_bill_id,
            bv.bill_version_id,
            t.trait_class,
            t.trait_id
           FROM civic_genome_bill_version bv
             JOIN civic_genome_prism_verification_binding b ON b.assembly_run_id = bv.assembly_run_id
             JOIN civic_genome_trait t ON t.trait_id = b.trait_id
        ), class_counts AS (
         SELECT version_traits.genome_bill_id,
            version_traits.bill_version_id,
            version_traits.trait_class,
            count(*) AS n
           FROM version_traits
          GROUP BY version_traits.genome_bill_id, version_traits.bill_version_id, version_traits.trait_class
        ), latest AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (civic_genome_bill_version.genome_bill_id) civic_genome_bill_version.genome_bill_id,
            civic_genome_bill_version.bill_version_id
           FROM civic_genome_bill_version
          ORDER BY civic_genome_bill_version.genome_bill_id, civic_genome_bill_version.stage_rank DESC NULLS LAST, civic_genome_bill_version.provider_sequence DESC NULLS LAST
        ), base AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (civic_genome_bill_version.genome_bill_id) civic_genome_bill_version.genome_bill_id,
            civic_genome_bill_version.base_bill_version_id
           FROM civic_genome_bill_version
          WHERE civic_genome_bill_version.base_bill_version_id IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY civic_genome_bill_version.genome_bill_id, civic_genome_bill_version.created_at
        ), extraction_coverage AS (
         SELECT civic_genome_bill_version.bill_version_id,
            true AS has_trait_coverage
           FROM civic_genome_bill_version
          WHERE (civic_genome_bill_version.processing_state = ANY (ARRAY['verified'::text, 'verified_with_findings'::text])) AND civic_genome_bill_version.assembly_run_id IS NOT NULL AND civic_genome_bill_version.prism_verification_run_id IS NOT NULL
        ), covered_classes AS (
         SELECT l.genome_bill_id,
            l.bill_version_id AS latest_bill_version_id,
            b.base_bill_version_id,
            cc.trait_class
           FROM latest l
             LEFT JOIN base b ON b.genome_bill_id = l.genome_bill_id
             JOIN class_counts cc ON cc.bill_version_id = l.bill_version_id OR cc.bill_version_id = b.base_bill_version_id
          GROUP BY l.genome_bill_id, l.bill_version_id, b.base_bill_version_id, cc.trait_class
        )
 SELECT c.genome_bill_id,
    c.trait_class,
    COALESCE(cb.n, 0::bigint) AS base_count,
    COALESCE(cl.n, 0::bigint) AS latest_count,
    COALESCE(cl.n, 0::bigint) - COALESCE(cb.n, 0::bigint) AS delta,
    COALESCE(bc.has_trait_coverage, false) AS base_has_trait_coverage,
    COALESCE(lc.has_trait_coverage, false) AS latest_has_trait_coverage
   FROM covered_classes c
     LEFT JOIN class_counts cb ON cb.bill_version_id = c.base_bill_version_id AND cb.trait_class = c.trait_class
     LEFT JOIN class_counts cl ON cl.bill_version_id = c.latest_bill_version_id AND cl.trait_class = c.trait_class
     LEFT JOIN extraction_coverage bc ON bc.bill_version_id = c.base_bill_version_id
     LEFT JOIN extraction_coverage lc ON lc.bill_version_id = c.latest_bill_version_id;

views.name: docket_bill_impact_callouts
views.definition:
WITH latest AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (civic_genome_bill_version.genome_bill_id) civic_genome_bill_version.genome_bill_id,
            civic_genome_bill_version.bill_version_id,
            civic_genome_bill_version.assembly_run_id
           FROM civic_genome_bill_version
          ORDER BY civic_genome_bill_version.genome_bill_id, civic_genome_bill_version.stage_rank DESC NULLS LAST, civic_genome_bill_version.provider_sequence DESC NULLS LAST
        ), bill_map AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT civic_genome_lifecycle_event_v2.genome_bill_id,
            civic_genome_lifecycle_event_v2.state_code,
            civic_genome_lifecycle_event_v2.source_bill_id
           FROM civic_genome_lifecycle_event_v2
        )
 SELECT bm.state_code,
    bm.source_bill_id AS bill_id,
    t.genome_bill_id,
    t.trait_id,
    t.trait_key,
        CASE t.normalized_value_json ->> 'override_type'::text
            WHEN 'source_stated_exception'::text THEN 'exception'::text
            WHEN 'source_stated_condition'::text THEN 'condition'::text
            WHEN 'source_stated_limitation'::text THEN 'limitation'::text
            WHEN 'source_stated_amendment_operation'::text THEN 'amendment_operation'::text
            ELSE 'unclassified'::text
        END AS callout_type,
    t.normalized_value_json ->> 'override_condition'::text AS condition_text,
    t.normalized_value_json ->> 'override_scope'::text AS scope_text,
    t.normalized_value_json ->> 'overridden_authority'::text AS overridden_authority,
    t.normalized_value_json ->> 'governing_section'::text AS governing_section,
    t.normalized_value_json ->> 'granting_actor'::text AS granting_actor,
    t.normalized_value_json ->> 'temporal_status'::text AS temporal_status,
    t.trait_fingerprint,
    t.extraction_run_id,
    t.methodology_version
   FROM civic_genome_trait t
     JOIN latest l ON l.genome_bill_id = t.genome_bill_id
     JOIN bill_map bm ON bm.genome_bill_id = t.genome_bill_id
  WHERE t.trait_class = 'override'::text AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM civic_genome_prism_verification_binding b
          WHERE b.trait_id = t.trait_id AND b.assembly_run_id = l.assembly_run_id));

views.name: docket_bill_obligation_checklist
views.definition:
WITH latest AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (civic_genome_bill_version.genome_bill_id) civic_genome_bill_version.genome_bill_id,
            civic_genome_bill_version.bill_version_id,
            civic_genome_bill_version.assembly_run_id
           FROM civic_genome_bill_version
          ORDER BY civic_genome_bill_version.genome_bill_id, civic_genome_bill_version.stage_rank DESC NULLS LAST, civic_genome_bill_version.provider_sequence DESC NULLS LAST
        ), bill_map AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT civic_genome_lifecycle_event_v2.genome_bill_id,
            civic_genome_lifecycle_event_v2.state_code,
            civic_genome_lifecycle_event_v2.source_bill_id
           FROM civic_genome_lifecycle_event_v2
        )
 SELECT bm.state_code,
    bm.source_bill_id AS bill_id,
    t.genome_bill_id,
    t.trait_id,
    s.step ->> 'step_id'::text AS step_id,
    (s.step ->> 'step_order'::text)::integer AS step_order,
    s.step ->> 'verb'::text AS verb,
    s.step ->> 'actor'::text AS actor,
    s.step ->> 'step_name'::text AS step_text,
    s.step ->> 'governing_section'::text AS governing_section,
        CASE
            WHEN (s.step ->> 'verb'::text) = 'may'::text THEN 'right_or_option'::text
            WHEN (s.step ->> 'verb'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['may not'::text, 'shall not'::text, 'must not'::text]) THEN 'prohibition'::text
            WHEN (s.step ->> 'verb'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['shall'::text, 'must'::text]) THEN 'mandate'::text
            ELSE 'unclassified'::text
        END AS tray,
        CASE
            WHEN (s.step ->> 'actor'::text) IS NULL THEN 'unknown'::text
            WHEN (s.step ->> 'actor'::text) ~* 'department|commission|agency|state|county|counties|treasurer|assessor|legislature|board|court|officer|official|superintendent|sheriff|chief|marshal|committee|authority|district|municipal|city|town|tribal|tribe'::text THEN 'institution'::text
            ELSE 'person_or_other'::text
        END AS actor_kind,
    t.trait_fingerprint,
    t.extraction_run_id,
    t.methodology_version
   FROM civic_genome_trait t
     JOIN latest l ON l.genome_bill_id = t.genome_bill_id
     JOIN bill_map bm ON bm.genome_bill_id = t.genome_bill_id
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(t.normalized_value_json -> 'steps'::text) s(step)
  WHERE t.trait_class = 'workflow'::text AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM civic_genome_prism_verification_binding b
          WHERE b.trait_id = t.trait_id AND b.assembly_run_id = l.assembly_run_id));

views.name: v_civic_genome_prism_verification_status
views.definition:
SELECT trait.trait_id,
    trait.genome_bill_id,
    trait.trait_class,
    trait.trait_key,
    trait.source_object_id,
    trait.content_hash AS trait_content_hash,
    binding.binding_id,
    binding.assembly_run_id,
    binding.request_id,
    binding.prism_verification_receipt_id,
    binding.prism_engine_version,
    binding.prism_rule_set_id,
    binding.prism_rule_set_version,
    binding.verification_status,
    binding.input_hash,
    binding.output_hash,
    binding.deterministic_replay_key,
    binding.created_at AS verified_at
   FROM civic_genome_trait trait
     LEFT JOIN civic_genome_prism_verification_binding binding ON binding.trait_id = trait.trait_id;
